description: Add comprehensive tests (unit, integration, property, smoke), .env.example with typed config validation, complete README, lint/typecheck/build commands, and standalone validation. Corresponds to subtasks 2.5, 2.6, and 2.7.
steps: Add vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, fast-check, @vitejs/plugin-react as exact-pinned devDependencies. Create vitest.config.ts with React/Next.js path aliases and test environment setup.
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts testing all authorization policies: owner access granted, member access limited, non-member denied, unauthenticated denied
Create tests/unit/server/config.test.ts testing aggregate config validation: missing required vars throws with all names listed, placeholder values detected, optional absence activates fake mode

Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts testing: webhook signature verification (valid signature processes event, invalid signature rejects with 400 and no state change), idempotent event processing (duplicate provider_event_id acknowledged without duplicate effect), subscription state transitions (checkout.session.completed creates subscription, customer.subscription.updated changes status, customer.subscription.deleted marks cancelled)
Create tests/unit/server/mail.test.ts testing: fake mode captures emails without sending, welcome email contains expected fields, invite email contains expected fields
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts testing: unauthenticated access to protected routes returns redirect/401, authenticated access succeeds, tenant-scoped access enforced

Create tests/integration/actions.test.ts testing: create tenant action succeeds for authenticated user, create project action enforces tenant membership, invite member action enforces owner/admin role

Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts implementing Property 4 (Authentication and access consistency): for any identity state and protected resource, access is granted iff authentication valid AND policy authorizes. Use fast-check to generate random auth contexts and verify deny-by-default consistency.

Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts implementing Property 5 (Webhook authenticity gates one state transition): for any webhook payload and signature, invalid proof produces non-success with unchanged state, valid recognized event produces transition at most once per unique provider_event_id. Use fast-check to generate random payloads/signatures.
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts as a smoke test verifying the project builds and key entry points exist

Create .env.example with all environment variables documented: each line has the var name, a placeholder value, and a comment marking it as client-safe|server-only and required|optional. Include: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STRIPE_PRICE_ID, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL

Update lib/server/config.ts to be the typed aggregate config validator: on startup, collects ALL missing/placeholder required server-only values and refuses with one error listing them all (never prints values). Optional values absent trigger fake/disabled fallback.

Create nextjs-supabase-saas/README.md following the Web SaaS family template: purpose/differentiators, supported runtime (Node 22 LTS, pnpm 10.x), folder structure map, ordered clean-setup procedure with commands and expected outcomes, environment table (dev vs prod), schema initialization (migrations), auth/authorization explanation, Stripe console setup/webhook configuration, Resend setup, representative flow description, one-shot commands (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run lint, pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run test, pnpm run build), troubleshooting, deployment (Vercel with managed Supabase/Stripe), license notes
Add ESLint configuration (eslint.config.mjs with @eslint/js, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-react) and lint script in package.json
Add typecheck script in package.json: tsc --noEmit
Ensure all one-shot commands are non-interactive and terminate with process status
Run the full validation sequence: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run lint, pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run test, pnpm run build - all must pass
Verify standalone independence: no imports from parent directories, no workspace: or file: or link: dependencies, no references to root package.json or other starter folders
acceptance_criteria: tests/ directory contains unit, integration, property, and smoke tests
Property 4 test (auth consistency) uses fast-check with 100+ cases and verifies deny-by-default
Property 5 test (webhook authenticity) uses fast-check with 100+ cases and verifies signature gating + idempotency
Stripe webhook tests cover: valid signature + state transition, invalid signature + no state change, duplicate event + no duplicate effect
Resend fake tests verify email capture without real sending
RLS/authz tests verify tenant isolation and role enforcement
.env.example lists every env var read by source with classification comments
README.md follows the Web SaaS family template with all required sections
pnpm run test passes (Vitest with all tests green)
No file:, link:, workspace:, or parent-path dependencies in package.json
